audit_items.proof_trace: The FlashLoan hot potato struct (no drop/store ability) guarantees same-transaction repayment in Move's type system — it can only be created by borrow_flash_loan and consumed by repay_flash_loan. The repayment check at L837 asserts coin.value() == inner.amount() + fee exactly, and a secondary check at reserve.move:245 verifies the principal equals the original loan amount. The reserve always receives back at minimum the full principal plus a non-zero fee portion.
